tasks.title: Reconcile stale canonical governance and PR state wording
tasks.goal: Remove stale governance, prerelease and pull-request wording from canonical docs after PR #15 while leaving historical audit and sprint artifacts untouched.

agentGoal.draft: /goal Reconcile residual canonical documentation wording after PR #15 so release, governance and current-state text matches the repository reality, verified by the light local gates.
agentGoal.outcome: Canonical docs stop referring to mandatory formal APPROVE review when branch protection does not require it, and docs/REVIEW.md no longer presents PR #15 as still pending.
agentGoal.verificationSurface: npm run doctor, npm run validate:templates, npm run validate:context, npm run validate:state, npm run validate:secrets, npm run validate:scope, npm run validate:docs, npm run validate:license and git diff --check
constraints: Do not rewrite historical audit reports or old sprint artifacts just because they mention older governance assumptions.

agentGoal.blockedStopCondition: Stop if the fix would require rewriting historical evidence instead of clarifying current canonical docs.
